svg.title: CPPI vs Buy & Hold | S&P 500 | 2018–2025
svg.desc: Daily portfolio wealth, initial 100 on 2017-12-29, through 2025-12-31. Annual floor reset to 90% of entering wealth. Buy & Hold ends at 256.04; CPPI ends at 136.33. Price index without dividends; zero interest and costs; 2012 observations including inception.
svg.metadata: Source: S&P Dow Jones Indices via FRED SP500, retrieved 2026-09-19. Derived educational calculation. Calendar-date x axis; linear wealth y axis 0–300, common to all four charts. No smoothing or resampling. Annual rules and limitations: portfolio-insurance.html#sp500-test.
